-- Einmaliger Strukturwechsel. Muss mit dem Eigentuemerkonto laufen,
-- weil ALTER TABLE dem schreibenden Konto nicht erlaubt ist.
ALTER TABLE edoobox_raw.booking
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS detail_synced_at timestamptz;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS booking_detail_offen_idx
    ON edoobox_raw.booking (detail_synced_at)
    WHERE detail_synced_at IS NULL;

-- Sicherstellen, dass das schreibende Konto die neue Spalte auch fuellen darf.
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
    ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA edoobox_raw TO n8n_writer;
GRANT USAGE, SELECT
    ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA edoobox_raw TO n8n_writer;

SELECT
    count(*)                                         AS buchungen,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE detail_synced_at IS NULL) AS noch_offen
FROM edoobox_raw.booking
WHERE is_deleted = false;
